title: Print Window Weighted Spacing
description: Replace inconsistent window spacing on cover pages with one canonical gap plus weight-normalized row/column/stack sizing. Implement SemioWindowStack and weighted SemioWindowRowTwo/Three macros.
summary: Implemented canonical `\semio@window@gap` (renamed header paint command to `\semio@window@header@gap@paint`), weight-normalized `\SemioWindowRowTwo`/`\SemioWindowRowThree`, and vertical `SemioWindowStack` push/prepare/use API. Rewired `\makecoverpages` to fill `\textheight` with weighted stack items and uniform 4pt gaps. Fixed `semio-table.sty` stale `\semio@window@gap` paint call and expl3/classic dimension bridging for row widths. Cover verification PDF builds (light+dark) via ticket `measure-spacing.ts`; several vertical inter-window gaps measure ~3.5–3.75pt at raster scale. Also fixed TOC sanitize/append guards for `Hy@SectionAnchorHref` junk and `seq_item` misuse.
